title: Photography & Walk in Stanley Park
includes: Photoshoot and complimentary photos at the end of the tour
DSLR camera can be borrowed, but any type of camera you bring will work
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have a high level of physical fitness
Pickup/drop off location can be decided upon booking; prefer downtown Vancouver otherwise anywhere in Vancouver for 2 or more people
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: You will explore Stanley Park, see the Totem Poles, walk along the Seawall, stop at Lost Lagoon, English Bay and Sunset Beach Park, all the while capturing the golden hour, wintery scenery, and sunsets. Also includes photography lessons with your DSLR or smartphone, as well as complimentary photoshoots.
